stories.title: The only MLB playoff preview you need: World Series odds, likely MVPs and how far all 8 remaining teams will go
stories.summary: Have Fall Classic or bust hopes this postseason? Here's why each remaining team could be playing late into October ... or get sent home next.

stories.title: Ravens' Hendrickson has surgery on finger, out vs. Titans
stories.summary: The Ravens will be without top pass rusher Trey Hendrickson against the Titans on Sunday after the outside linebacker had surgery for a broken finger.

stories.title: 49ers owner York suspended six games, fined $500,000 for personal conduct violation
stories.summary: 49ers owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy stemming from his August arrest after he tried to engage in prostitution in Ohio.

stories.title: Romo won't return as NFL analyst, CBS Sports says
stories.summary: Tony Romo will not return as an NFL game analyst for CBS Sports, the network announced, after he was arrested in July on charges of operating a vehicle while intoxicated.

stories.title: Patriots' defense loses Gonzalez, Barmore against high-octane Bills
stories.summary: The New England Patriots will be without starting cornerback Christian Gonzalez and defensive tackle Christian Barmore due to a shoulder injury when they visit the Bills on Sunday.
